title: Golden Visa For Manager in UAE: 10-Year Residency Success
description: Looking to apply for the Golden Visa For Manager in UAE? Learn the income requirements, job roles, and complete process to get long-term UAE residency.

featuredImage.alt: Golden Visa For Manager in UAE

contentHtml:
Are you a manager earning AED 30,000 or more each month, overseeing teams, and helping your company grow in the UAE? Then you might already qualify for something incredible — the golden visa for manager category. If you’ve never considered applying, now is the perfect time. This visa offers long-term residency, unmatched freedom, and the chance to truly call the UAE your permanent home. Sounds ideal? It’s not a dream — it’s a real opportunity.

This blog is your go-to guide if you’re a General Manager in Dubai, a Director in Abu Dhabi, or a CEO in Sharjah. Let’s walk you through every detail: from eligibility requirements and application steps to key benefits and tips to improve your chances.

Who qualifies?

  • What documents do you need, and
  • How to apply

What Is the UAE Golden Visa for Managers?

The UAE Golden Visa is a government-backed initiative. Designed to attract top talent, from investors to executives. Launched in 2019, the goal is to retain people who drive growth. One who can lead teams and contribute to national development.

The visa offers a renewable 10-year residency for managers and senior executives. It’s not tied to your employer, unlike traditional visas. That means you stay in control. Even if you switch jobs or launch your own business.

Why UAE Managers Should Consider the Golden Visa?

Without a doubt, the benefits of the golden visa are a game-changer for managerial-level positions. Giving them a chance to upgrade their lives in the world’s best economies.

Life-Changing Golden Visa Benefits at a Glance:

  • Residency for 10 years gives long-term peace of mind. The visa is not tied to any employer
  • You can bring your spouse, children, and even housemaids
  • You can start a business or invest in real estate with 100% ownership
  • Maintain your visa if you are away from the UAE for longer than six months.
  • You can open accounts, secure loans, and invest with ease

Golden Visas aren’t just about residency, they’re about upgrading your lifestyle and career freedom.

Is It Just for Investors? No! Managers Qualify Too

There’s a common misconception that the Golden Visa is only for entrepreneurs or millionaires. But that’s far from the truth. If you’re a salaried executive or manager, you’re equally eligible. Provided you meet a few simple criteria.

Golden Visa Eligibility for Managers

Meet the following criteria to be eligible for the Golden Visa under the managerial category:

  • Hold a senior job title or executive position. Including General Manager, Director, CEO, or Board Member.
  • Earn a minimum salary of AED 30,000/month. This must be reflected in both your contract and bank statement.
  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a managerial role.
  • Work under a valid UAE residence visa.
  • Hold a university degree, attested by the UAE Ministry of Education.
  • Have a clean legal and security record.

Consider the above Dubai Golden Visa for manager requirements when applying for a visa. You’ll also need a NOC from your employer. The No Objection Certificate is required to proceed with the application.

Golden Visa Documents Checklist for Managers

Before starting your application, gather the following documents:

Personal Identification

  • Copy of Emirates ID (valid and clear)
  • Copy of Passport (valid for at least 6 months)
  • Copy of current UAE visa with a color scan, full page
  • Passport-size photo including a white background, recent

Employment & Salary

  • An employment contract showing your job title and salary
  • Salary certificate in Arabic, showing AED 30,000+ and company stamp
  • NOC letter from employer (Arabic and signed)
  • Bank statements for the last 6 months, clearly showing salary deposits
  • Experience letter confirming 5+ years in a managerial role

Education & Health

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, attested by the UAE Ministry of Education
  • Valid UAE health insurance policy

How to Apply for the Golden Visa?

Have you made up your mind to apply for a Golden Visa as a manager in the UAE? Follow the process below to obtain your long-term residency ticket:

Step 1: Prepare Your Documents

Scan and organize all the documents. Missing any document can delay your application.

Step 2: Submit Your Application

Use one of the official platforms:

  • ICP Smart Services Portal (for most emirates)
  • GDRFA Dubai Portal (for applicants based in Dubai)

Choose the category: Skilled Professionals – Managerial Category.

Step 3: Schedule Your Medical Test

You’ll need to take a chest X-ray and blood test as part of your visa medical.

Step 4: Register for the Emirates ID

Apply for a new Emirates ID after visa approval. It is valid for 10 years.

Step 5: Enjoy the Benefits

You’re officially a Golden Visa holder once everything’s processed. Welcome to long-term living in the UAE.

We’ve already published a detailed blog on my website that contains complete information about “How to apply golden visa in UAE”. Go and check it out.

All set to get a golden visa but still confused about the cost? The table below helps. Let’s find out how it costs you:

Top 5 Reasons This Visa is a Game-Changer for Executives

The list is quite long when we talk about the reasons to obtain a golden visa. For instance, we have gathered a few top considerations that make you think about a golden visa to secure your future:

  1. You Control Your Future – Switch jobs, invest, or launch a business without visa worries.
  2. Family Comes First – Easily sponsor and secure residency for your loved ones.
  3. You Gain Stability – With a 10-year visa, you plan long-term housing, education, and investments.
  4. Career-Friendly – Your visa remains valid even if you resign or are between jobs.
  5. A Legacy of Leadership – You become part of a select group driving the UAE’s progress.

FAQS

Q1: Can I apply by myself?

Yes, but hiring a visa service minimizes mistakes and saves time.

Q2: Can I still get the Golden Visa if I invest in real estate?

Yes, property investments of AED 2 million or more also qualify you for a Golden Visa.

Q3: Will I lose my visa if I leave my job?

Your visa is based on your qualifications and income. It is not tied to your current employer. Therefore, you are not dependent on anyone.

Q4: Can my family stay if something happens to me?

The dependents can remain in the UAE. Even if the main visa holder passes away.

Q5: How long does the process take?

Usually 2–4 weeks. Using a visa service can speed it up.

Q6: Do I have to renew my golden visa every year?

The golden visa is valid for 10 years. It can be renewed with updated documents, and when it expires, usually after 10 years.

Final Thoughts: Your Executive Journey Starts Here

The Golden Visa for managerial positions is more than just paperwork. In actuality, it’s your ticket to long-term career and lifestyle freedom in the UAE. This is your moment if you’ve built your career and now want to secure your future.

Gather your documents, and consider expert help if needed. Be ready to take the next step toward long-term residency.
